reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate that every holiday check in the tree already uses, and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is a single extra comparison in the one predicate.

placement.why: The holiday matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it, with a type comment documenting the format.

scope.why: Touches only the predicate, a type comment, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable; the day.slice(5) trick relies implicitly on the YYYY-MM-DD layout of dayFromDate, which a comment explains.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all callers (shared/schedules, schedules/app, schedule-template) reach holidays through isWeekendOrHoliday
